verses.1: Except Jehovah build the house, They labor in vain that build it: Except Jehovah keep the city, The watchman waketh but in vain.
verses.2: It is vain for you to rise up early, To take rest late, To eat the bread of toil; For so he giveth unto his beloved sleep.
verses.3: Lo, children are a heritage of Jehovah; And the fruit of the womb is his reward.
verses.4: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, So are the children of youth.
verses.5: Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them: They shall not be put to shame, When they speak with their enemies in the gate.
